Title: A very, very, very Fine House

Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
Hi another rules question.

Situation:

A methuselah's Master phase, Jost Werner is in Torpor with zero blood, He wants to play Secure Haven.

Master: unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be the target of other Methuselahs' actions. Any Methuselah burns an additional pool when playing master cards on (or that target) this minion. Burn this card if this minion enters torpor. A minion may have only one haven.

So it says playable on any minion you control that is ok, but now he is in torpor, does it burn right away? Or only if he enters torpor again?

Thank you kindly

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
It is burned only if he enters torpor, thus you can play Secure Haven on Jost in torpor and he will keep the haven.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
Great thanks.

He is pretty safe from diabelrie now, except Vulnerability or Crematorium...any other new cards I need to worry about being able to burn him, until I can get another minion to rescue?

Thanks again

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answer from jhattara.

(Also notice: a Secure haven on an Imbued won't burn when the Imbued enters the incapacited area.. which means an Imbued with a Secure Haven is pretty safe)

> Great thanks.
>
> He is pretty safe from diabelrie now, except Vulnerability or Crematorium...any other new cards I need to worry about being able to burn him, until I can get another minion to rescue?
>
> Thanks again
>
Correct. Also notice you are the only player who could rescue that guy.

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
> delangen wrote:
> Great thanks.
>
> He is pretty safe from diabelrie now, except Vulnerability or Crematorium...any other new cards I need to worry about being able to burn him, until I can get another minion to rescue?
>
> Thanks again
>
Society of Leopold, White Nights Massacre, Auto-da-fé, The Eldest Command Undeath and Veles' Hunt are all cards that could be used to burn empty Jost with Secure Haven in torpor.

Also these masters could allow someone to steal your Secured Jost from torpor: Hostile Takeover, Temptation of Greater Power, From a Sinking Ship (if you have 3 pool or less) and Grand Temple of Set (with 7 counters on it).

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> delangen wrote:
> He is pretty safe from diabelrie now, except Vulnerability or Crematorium...any other new cards I need to worry about being able to burn him, until I can get another minion to rescue?
>
Just to make sure you know... cards such as Arson, Rampage etc. can be used to burn the Secure Haven. Its prohibition on  actions protects the minion, not the Secure Haven itself. So someone can burn the location and then diablerize you.

Messages.Author: Malcolm Sprye
Messages.Body: Also good to note is that the secure haven will prevent other people from rescuing you as well.
